note: GD.32: org routing for the JVM. lib's pom declares no groupId of its own: it inherits com.acme from <parent>, so the walk records its PROJECT's coordinate com.acme:acme-lib (the label stays the bare artifactId acme-lib); glib's build.gradle sets `group = 'com.acme'` and settings.gradle `rootProject.name = 'glib'`, coordinate com.acme:glib. Identity keys each PROJECT by its coordinate, so app's pom dependency (package:maven:com.acme:acme-lib) and gapp's `implementation 'com.acme:glib:1.0'` each form one manifest_name class. app's Main.java `import com.acme.lib.Greeter` routes to lib's Greeter.java (IMPORTS, resolver:org_packages rule org_import) and `Greeter.shout(..)` binds through the CLASS to its METHOD (CALLS, rule org_call, Medium); gapp's App.kt `import com.acme.glib.Util` and `Util.twice(..)` the same. Baseline HEAD 2fc4daa9 (this fixture, debug CLI): `[identity] report classes=0`, no [org-packages] line, no edge between the repos.
